label: Huawei OptiXstar S600E GPON SFP ONU
description: GPON ONU built into an SFP module (HiSilicon SD5182S, UX5176 BOSA) that plugs into a router's SFP/SFP+ cage with a GE/2.5GE/5GE/10GE adaptive host interface; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on SC/APC (ITU-T G.984.2 Class B+), no RJ45 LAN ports and no Wi-Fi. Also sold as the MA5671B, successor to the MA5671A; the XGS-PON version is the OptiXstar S800E.
